buggy_findings.mechanism: The copied implementation/spec table can drift in lockstep, so the proof is an in-file review oracle rather than external protocol conformance.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Change one accepted row in both executable and spec and identify which independent source/model/ELF evidence rejects it.

buggy_findings.mechanism: Forward typed-to-integer refinement permits extra accepted integer rows outside the typed code image and does not establish observable-code injectivity.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Add an accepted integer row outside the encoder image and collide two acknowledgement codes; require image-completeness and injectivity proofs to fail.

buggy_findings.mechanism: The outer frame postcondition has no verified consumer, so deleting a conjunct leaves verification and aggregate obligation counts green.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Delete or narrow each material postcondition while holding the implementation fixed and require a consumer proof or contract-inventory gate to fail.

buggy_findings.mechanism: A commented-out no-default command satisfies raw-text enforcement while workspace feature unification executes only the default implementation.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Comment out the crate-specific command and inject an error only in the no-default body; require normal and fast gates to fail.

buggy_findings.mechanism: A hardcoded archive digest includes absolute sysroot paths, so it rejects independent qualification even when base and candidate are byte-identical together.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Build the pair under two HOME/sysroot path lengths and separate same-environment equality from portable absolute identity.
